scope: 2016 base/core multiplayer, no Automa, expansions, or optional variants

method.independence: Read complete extracted rulebook and only the five authorized iteration files. No other iteration, grades, prior review, or parent history was consulted.
method.unit: Each reader answer is graded independently against its own question and source. Its own evidence may clarify the answer record. No facts are borrowed from other answers or from the summary to repair an omission.
method.correct: All requested material parts are resolved and source-correct.
method.partial: A requested material part is omitted or unresolved, with no material contradiction.
method.incorrect: A material source contradiction is stated.
method.key_scope: Expected answers are reference material, not mandatory checklists of unasked extras. Support labels do not determine semantic grades.
method.source_limitation: The extraction omits numeric values rendered only in scoring/structure diagrams. For those diagram-only values, the authorized answer key identifies inspected-diagram values and supplies the comparison; I did not inspect a PDF or claim independent diagram verification.
